svg.text: $ # a resumed session tries to Write after 3 unclaimed mutating calls…
🔒 claim-gate: 4 mutating actions in 'kigali' with NO task lock.
Resumed/compacted sessions don't fire the /claim reminder — this is that gap.
Run /claim "<task>" (or /track) to register the lock, then retry.
Reads, Bash, and Skills still work; only file edits + Task are gated.
$ # …and a session tries to END without running its retro to convergence:
⛔ close-retro-stop-gate: close-pending is armed but retro has not converged.
/session-retro must run its convergence loop (min 2 passes, delta < 3).
An inline 'summary of learnings' does NOT satisfy this gate.
✓ Real output. The gates are hooks — you cannot politely talk your way past them.
